Birthdate: June 18, 1960

27 Bender Bay
Winnipeg, Manitoba
Canada R2P 2M7

EDUCATION

Master of Science, Dept of Plant Science, Univ. of Manitoba, 1988. Major, minor: Cereal Chemistry, Biochemistry. Thesis: "Characterization of the interaction of Barley Alpha-Amylase II with an Endogenous Alpha-Amylase Inhibitor from Barley Kernels"
Bachelor of Science (4 Year Degree), Univ. of Winnipeg, 1983. Major, minor: Biology, Biochemistry. Thesis: "Phytochrome in a Heterophyllic Aquatic Macrophyte Potamogeton amplifolius, Tukerm"

Honour Roll Graduate, Oak Park High School, Winnipeg, Manitoba, 1978.

University of Manitoba Graduate Fellowship, September, 1984

University of Winnipeg, Senate Proficiency Scholarship, September, 1982.
